attribution.note: Zitron directly asserts the revenue figure in his own narrative and endorses it, although he identifies Reuters reporting on the S-1 as its source.

semantics.note: The revenue component is a separable historical assertion. Calendar-year realized revenue, the S-1 accounting basis, and one-decimal rounding fit the surrounding context.

contract.note: Using annual GAAP revenue from the expressly named S-1 reasonably operationalizes the statement. Rounding to one decimal preserves its precision without substituting an annualized run rate.

evidence.note: The packet supplies an archived company filing available October 26, before the cutoff. Its audited annual statements report 2025 revenue of $4,585 million. Dividing by 1,000 gives $4.585 billion, which rounds to $4.6 billion. This is a company financial disclosure, not independent reporting.

output.rationale: The filed annual revenue matches the company, period, currency, and accounting basis required by the contract and rounds to the asserted amount. No material counterevidence appears in the packet. This assessment covers revenue only, not the accompanying loss assertion.
